assertions.description: CSS.highlights exposes the HighlightRegistry the universal selector styles against.
Highlight is a constructor taking Range objects.
A named ::highlight(name) rule is accepted by insertRule (the pre-existing surface the universal form extends).
CSS.supports reports the universal form: selector(::highlight(*)).
insertRule accepts a ::highlight(*) rule instead of throwing SyntaxError.
A ::highlight(*) rule placed after a named rule still loses to it: the * argument contributes zero specificity, so the universal declarations act only as a base.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof Highlight!=='function')return false;const el=document.createElement('p');el.textContent='zero specificity probe';el.style.cssText='position:absolute;visibility:hidden;';document.body.appendChild(el);const r=new Range();r.setStart(el.firstChild,0);r.setEnd(el.firstChild,4);CSS.highlights.set('conformance-zspec',new Highlight(r));let ok=false;try{const s=new CSSStyleSheet();s.insertRule("::highlight(conformance-zspec) { background-color: rgb(1, 2, 3); }",0);s.insertRule("::highlight(*) { background-color: rgb(9, 9, 9); }",1);document.adoptedStyleSheets=[...document.adoptedStyleSheets,s];const v=getComputedStyle(el,'::highlight(conformance-zspec)').backgroundColor;ok=/rgb\(\s*1\s*,\s*2\s*,\s*3\s*\)/.test(v);document.adoptedStyleSheets=document.adoptedStyleSheets.filter(x=>x!==s);}catch(e){ok=false;}CSS.highlights.delete('conformance-zspec');el.remove();return ok;})()

assertions.description: The registry is maplike: set/get/has/delete round-trip a named Highlight.
Highlight exposes the priority attribute the annotator pattern uses to resolve overlapping categories.
